segments.name: building products
segments.description: Distributes residential and commercial building products, grouped into specialty and structural categories, to dealers, home centers and industrial manufacturers across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: building products. The segment sells building products that are grouped into two primary categories: specialty products and structural products.

revenueModel.text: Customers such as national home centers, pro dealers, cooperatives and industrial manufacturers pay for building products purchased from manufacturers and distributed through warehouse, reload and direct channels.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company is a two-step distributor and purchases products from manufacturers and distributes those products to dealers and other suppliers in local markets, who then sell those products to end users.
